title: Second Lessons: Stone
introNarration: Quern taps the Primer. Granite-dust greys both paws. He does not hurry the next sentence. "Cast keystone at the hearth dummy in this room. Then talk to me. After that, the Primer will hold one ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name."
reminderNarration: Cast keystone at the hearth dummy in this hearth, then talk to Quern. Weight first. Speech second.
completionNarration: The second hearth lesson is done. The Primer rests on the keystone shelf as if it had always belonged there. Open the Primer and type ink and the vein's name.
